translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: APOSEL
book.title: APOSEL Aposel tame eme kerebetem yaku.

content: Kristen nogwape eme Jerusalemke wurik sin tuma namdebetem.
Kau tame eme Judia distrik mesginin yeirin Antiok komke yam, eme Kristen lakemase emne tuma etep wom. Warege Moses eri wule kem beke kip se, kem somo beke kip kwun, God ere kemne sene beke kip pet.

Etep womke, Polken Barnabasken epe etep metem, epe Judiak yam tame emne pap kenake wayen etemken nakwosem. Nakwosem, Kristen tame eme tuma namden etep wom. Pol, Barnabas, Antiokri Kristen tameken emne nema Jerusalemke won yite. Nakwosem tuma eme aposel tame etemken Kristen lakere tameken eme ete tuma namden gerute. Etep wom.

Antiokri Kristen tatame eme emne Jerusalemke yite wom, eme Fonisia distrikke Samaria distrikke yibetem, eme Kristen tatame emne etep wobetem. Tatame nogwape akeite komri, eme Kristen tem. Etep wom. Kristen lakemase eme etep metem, eme metekwasem.
Eme Jerusalemke yam, Kristen tatame, aposel tame, Kristen lakere tameken eme etemne petem. Sene eme emne God eter nenem woskap emne wusowum.
Wusowum, kau Kristen tame eme Farisi tame supa, eme teten etep wom. Juda berai tame eme Kristen tete, kem emne somo kwunte. Kem emne wote, eme Moses eteri wule kir tobote. Etep wom.
Aposel tameken Kristen lakere tameken eme wurik sin ete tuma eme etemwou namdem.

Tuma nogwape namdebetem, Pita ere teten etep wom. Ari lakemase, kem metem, kiyi God ere nemne yaku newopit peteyamke, ere arene etep wom. Areri tuma yenbo ne Juda berai tatame etemne wusoute, eme kir meten kenawaike abote. Etep wom.
God ere tame emri selpap labe. Ere Eri Wou nemne newomkap, ere etemne kir newom. Newomke, ere nemne peteram, Juda berai tatame eme erne kenawaike abote, e yenbo.
God ere etemken neremken kenakena beke la. Ere nemne wurisubuk lakerebe. God ere nemri wule yaper peten sepitimkap, eme God erne kenawaike abom, eke ere etemri wule yaper kir peten sepitim.

Beke kem God erne seilabe? Moses eri wule, yeiwarege etemri wule e lumken woskap. Kiyi nemri yeiwarege, nerem kir, nema lumken wos kuyese mapeke se. Eke, ete lumken wos kem Kristen emne mane won sete. Kem etep tete, God ere pap yaper tete nenbe.
Aneyen Jisas ere Juda berai tatame emne pap yewon ere tatame etemri nenbetem wule yaperke sam, epkap God ere emne sene petem. Nema etepke tetan. Jisas ere nemne pap yewon, God ere nemne sene petem.

Etek temenem tame eme tuma rebe tem. Eme wan taimenem, Barnabasken Polken etepri tumawou metem. Epe tuma wusowum, epe Juda berai tatame etemken temenem tuma, God ere epri letke nenbetem eisau woskap epe etep wusowum.
Tuma wusowun omomke, Jems ere etep wom. Lake, kem ari tuma ek met.
Saimon Pita ere kemne wusouye. Kiyi Juda berai tatame eme God eri tatame beke te. Sene God ere emne pap yewon, ere tatame kau emne petem, eme eteri yen tem.
Kiyi temenem tuma wusoubetem tame eme ete tuma kir wom. An God eteri siglouke bas rasten tuma kemne wusoute.
Eme etepke bas rasem.

content.text: Keryen God ere etep wom. Yuri an sene yate nenbe. Devit eteri tame supa, Juda tatame eme wule yaper nenbetem, an emne sene yenbo nente. Eme terem akekap an ete ake ager sene kerete.
Juda berai tatame eme ane sopte nenbe. Juda berai tatame, an emne kiyi kenem tatame eme ane sopte. Etep wom.
Kiyisape God ere ete tuma wom, ere etep som wobe.

content: Eme etep bas rasem.
Jems ere sene etep wom. An gwopke abobe. Juda berai tatame eme God erne pap yewobe, nema emne lumken wos mane newote. Nema emne somo kwun tuma mane wote.

Nema emne siglou bas rasen newopitte. Nema emne etep wote. Sukye kwar pebe kiti kem mane ate. Kem sir bisi mane yite. Wak kepke peiken sabe por, nepken kiti kem mane ate. Nep kem mane ate. Nema etep bas raste.
Ete tuma, Moses eri bas rasem wule eme God eteri akek lan wusoube. Ege si yabel nogwape eme kom nogwapek wusoube. Kiyisape eme etep tebetem. Jems ere etep wom.
Eme akeite Kristen emne siglou bas rasen newopitim.

Aposel tame etem, Kristen lakere tame, Jisas erne kenawaike abobetem tame etem, eme sin tuma namdem. Namden eme etemri tame pes epne wom. Polken Barnabasken etep Antiokke yite wom, eme Kristen apeilake pes epne kir yite wom. Tame wuri, Judas, eteri akeite sig Barsabas, eme erne wom. Sailas eterne eme kir wom.

Womke, eme tuma bas rasen epne newon epe peten sen yim. Siglou ere etep wom. Nema aposel tame, nema Kristen lakerebe tameken nema kemri lakemase. Kem neremri lakemase, kem Antiokke tetan, kem Siria provinske tetan, Silisia provinske tetan tatame, nema kemne gwo siglou bas rasen kemne pir wobe.
Nema metem, nemri tamesip eme yin kemne wom, kem pap pes tem. Nema emne beke wo, eme kena abon yim.
Nema tuma namden nema apeilake pes wom, epe kemne yan late. Tame pes Barnabasken Polken nema epne metekwasbe, nema wom tame pes epe etepken kemne yan late. Nema epne metekwasbe.
Epe sa beke ak, epe kom komke yin Aneyen Jisas Krais eteri tuma wusoubetem.
Nema Judasken Sailasken epne won yibe, epe gwo siglouri tuma sene kemne wusoute.
God Eteri Wou ere womkap nema kir wobe. Nema kemne akeite lumken wos kemne beke kip newo. Gwote wule etewou kem tobote.

Sukye o arkwu kwar pebe kiti kem mane ate. Nep kem mane ate. Wak kepke peiken sabe por nepken kiti kem mane ate. Kem sir bisi mane yite. Ete wule yaper kem lan ganke amekwunte, kem yaku yenbo kerete. Tuma ab eteke. Siglou bas rasem tuma etepke wom.
Eme emne won Antiokke yim, eme Jisas erne kenawaike abobetem tatame emne wopeten wurisubuk sin siglou ek newom.
Newom, eme peten lan eme tuma yenbo lam, eme pap yenbo ten metekwasem.
Judasken Sailasken epe God eteri tuma wusoubetem tame, epe tuma nogwape sene emne wusowun eme pap yenbo metem, eme mureken tem.
Yabel nogwape epe Antiokke tem, yuri Kristen eme epne pir won epne won yam tame etemke sene yite wom.
(Sailas ere eteri porerek, ere Antiok etek temenem.)
Polken Barnabasken epe Antiokke som temenem. Temenem, epe Kristen nogwape etemken eme Aneyen Jisas eri tuma yenbo emne wusoubetem.
Polken Barnabasken epe ei nakwosen epe kenakena yim.
Yuri Pol ere Barnabas erne etep wom. Nesa yite. Kiyi nesa sewurbetem, nesa komri komri lakemase emne tuma wusoubetem, eme kap yenbo tetan o? Nesa emne sene yin late.
Barnabas ere Jon, eri sig wuri Mak, erne panen etepken yite wom.
Pol ere mo won etep wom. Jon Mak ere kiyi nesetken yim, nema Pamfilia provinske yin ere nesetne mesginin sene yim. Ere nesetken yaku beke kere. Sene nesa erne beke kip panen yi.
Etep won, epe ei nakwosem. Barnabas ere Jon Mak erne panen epe sip peten Saiprus ailanke yim.
Pol ere Sailas erne panen yim. Yim, Kristen eme epne etep wom. Aneyen Jisas ere kepne kobo lan yenbo nente. Etep wom.
Epe yin ere Siriaken Silisiaken etek yin ere Kristen tatame emne mure newobetem.
